OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

<groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>

The build is green. All 3 tests in `Cp01Tests` pass, including the new required-fields checks.

## Summary

I implemented rejection of owner creation when any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is missing or blank, responding with **400** and a JSON body containing an `errors` array naming each offending field.

Changes:

1. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — added explicit missing/blank validation (`isBlank` treats `null` and whitespace-only strings as blank). If any of the five required fields is blank, it throws a new `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` carrying the field names.

2. **`InvalidOwnerFieldsException`** (new) — a `RuntimeException` in the `rest.advice` package holding the list of rejected field names.

3. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — added an `@ExceptionHandler` for `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` that returns 400 with an `errors` property listing the field names. I also enhanced the existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler to expose the same `errors` array.

The second change matters because the OpenAPI-generated `OwnersApi` interface carries `@Valid @RequestBody`, so Bean Validation (`@NotNull` for missing fields, `@Pattern`/`@Size` for the telephone) actually fires *before* the controller body runs. Both validation paths — bean validation and the controller's own whitespace check (which catches blank values that bean validation misses on pattern-less fields like `city`) — now produce a consistent `{"errors": [...]}` response. This satisfies the test asserting `$.errors` contains `"city"` for a missing field and 400 for a blank telephone, while keeping a complete owner accepted.
